description: A project's CALENDAR: the occurrences of its events — classes, rehearsals, rentals, anything with a start and an end on the clock — that overlap a window, earliest first. A repeating event (a weekly class) is one event with 'recurrence' (an RFC 5545 RRULE, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO) and appears once per occurrence. Each occurrence has 'eventId' and 'occurrence' — the start its rule gives it, e.g. 20261123T150000Z, which names it in set_calendar_occurrence even after it was moved — 'start'/'end' (UTC, where it actually is), 'title', 'location', 'labels', 'timeZone' (the wall clock the rule repeats on), 'changed' (this one was moved or retitled), 'cancelled' (only with withCancelled), 'issueKey' (the issue it is about) and 'externalId'. Not issues' due dates: those are on the issues. Any member may read.

from.description: Window start, ISO 8601 (2026-11-23 or 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z). Default: yesterday.

label.description: Only events carrying this label (a track, a group).

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601. Default: a week after the start. At most 400 days after it.

withCancelled.description: true to include cancelled occurrences, marked 'cancelled'.

name: list_calendar_events
title: List calendar events
